Line 2 (the <=$50 aggregate, never itemized) is likewise nil in all three columns. Per the zero-glyph ruling the slashed glyphs are 0.

That equals the cover's line-3 THIS REPORT cell (933.19) AND its CUMULATIVE cell (933.19) - they coincide because this is the FIRST report of the cycle (the line-3 LAST REPORT cell reads 'N/A'), so the scope is recorded cumulative. gates.balance_chain: Carr cover has no beginning-balance line. Contributions 0 - expenses 933.19 = -933.19, yet the printed line-4 balance is +933.19: the filer used line 4 as a running EXPENSE total, not as cash on hand (both line 3 and line 4 read 933.19 in the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns). That is the filer's own convention, retained verbatim, not a transcription defect.
